d: Company Description GFS Express is a leading provider of shipping and delivery services, offering integrated solutions for transportation, storage, and customs clearance. The company focuses on delivering high-quality, reliable services to support clients’ logistics and supply chain needs. By combining operational efficiency with strong customer service, GFS Express helps businesses move goods smoothly and securely. Team members join a fast-paced, service-oriented environment where attention to detail and continuous improvement are valued.
q: Minimum 2 years of experience in HR and Administration.
At least 1 year of experience in the logistics industry
Familiarity with HR operations, employee relations, payroll, recruitment, and administrative procurement.
Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and positive working attitude.
Passionate about work, responsible, detail-oriented, and able to handle multiple tasks independently.
Good Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Fluent in both Arabic and English , with good written and verbal communication skills.
Knowledge of Oman's labor laws and government procedures is preferred
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Strong ownership, accountability, and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to collaborate with different departments and operational teams.
r: GFS, a logistics company, is looking for a motivated and responsible HR & Administration Officer to support our HR and administrative operations in Oman.

The successful candidate will be responsible for recruitment, payroll coordination, employee relations, government relations, and administrative procurement. We are looking for someone with relevant logistics industry experience, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including job postings, CV screening, interviews, and onboarding.
Handle payroll preparation, attendance, leave management, and employee compensation records.
Manage employee relations, including employee inquiries, complaints, disciplinary matters, and resignation procedures.
Maintain employee files, employment contracts, and HR documentation.
Support performance management and HR policy implementation.
Handle government-related procedures and employee documentation.
Coordinate with relevant government authorities regarding labor permits, employment matters, and other regulatory requirements.
Ensure compliance with local labor laws and government regulations.
Follow up on employee-related government transactions and renewals.
Manage daily office and administrative operations.
Handle administrative procurement, including office supplies, warehouse consumables, and other operational requirements.
Coordinate with suppliers, obtain quotations, follow up on purchase orders, and monitor deliveries.
Maintain procurement records, payment requests, and administrative expenses.

Department: Internal Audit, Risk and Compliance services
q: Minimum Degree in Accounting or equivalent (CIA, CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA). Certification in Risk Management would be an added advantage.
Must have 3-4 years of professional internal audit, Enterprise Risk Management and/or Risk Assurance experience with a minimum of 2 years in a Senior capacity.
Is a self-starter and able to work independently; ensures work is accurate and completed in a professional manner.
Bilingual in English and Arabic is an added advantage.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to apply conceptual frameworks to new and unique situations.
Strong general business knowledge and understanding of financial statements and operational processes.
Good understanding of regulatory requirements (Labor Law, CMA regulations, CBK regulations, Company Law)
Effective communication skills (verbal and written) with a stakeholder-focused orientation and the ability to listen, understand and customize communications to the stakeholders’ benefit.
Well-developed time management, and ability to effectively manage competing priorities.
r: Independently develop RCMs (Risk and Controls Matrices) covering various business areas and support functions.
Able to effectively define scope of work and internal audit procedures.

Perform risk assessments by gaining an understanding of, and documenting the respective business processes, identifying risks and controls inherent in those processes, evaluating them and identifying control deficiencies/opportunities for improvement; evaluates control effectiveness through transaction testing; and performs substantive audit procedures; and identify weaknesses in governance, risk management and controls processes.
Constantly reviews work products performed by junior team members to ensure quality.
Effectively draft internal audit reports of findings, implication and recommendations.

Assist in development of ERM practices, including development of a risk management framework, performing risk assessments, determining overall risk capacities and appetites, developing risk ranking criteria, identifying risks, risk responses and controls, quantifying risk exposures, communicating risk results, monitoring controls, identifying Key Risk Indicators and management oversight.

d: To arrange and supervise the receipts, storage, and dispatches of products to achieve the company’s business plan. Deputize the Distribution Centre Manager in his absence.
q: Graduate in B. Com or Equivalent Experience.
3 years supervisory experience in Logistics & Supply chain
Good knowledge of Quality Assurance elements and implementation
Good communication skills, high degree of Initiative and ownership, leadership qualities
r: Plan the daily effective use of resources, manage and handle floor and delivery operations to maximize productivity.
Incoming and Delivery trucks routing & scheduling
Plan daily incoming truck offloading to maximize staff productivity.
Plan and schedule the routing effectively and efficiently in order to meet delivery lead-time target and maximize fleet utilization.
Generate pick slips and distribute them to picking team to support delivery schedule.
Ensure quantity of goods loaded / received are as per order quantity to facilitate cycle counts are conducted and reconciled weekly to achieve inventory record accuracy.
Verify and confirm the quantity and quality of goods returned from trade as per documents to avoid customer complaints and stock variations
Collection of payment / Invoice Delivery Confirmation
Ensure all invoices are returned to the warehouse on same day of delivery signed by the customer as proof of delivery.
Incoming / outgoing product quality and SOP’s
Ensure quality of goods offloaded and loaded is perfect and that the offloading / loading patterns will not create damage / trade returns.
Ensure that incoming / outgoing trailers and trucks are inspected and are in perfect condition in order to comply with QA standards.
Ensure that picking and delivery staff are regularly trained / qualified and their performance regularly reviewed to achieve desired picking / delivery accuracy.
